translations.adaptations: Scope is default non-OOF tblastn, with fixed six frames; full/out-of-frame mixed translation branches are not claimed. Borrowed first-nucleotide NCBI4na slice and genetic-code table replace external BLAST_SequenceBlk pointers, with typed lifetimes. Option<Vec<u8>> buffers and fixed12-element range array retain source allocation/reuse/cache geometry; consuming an Option owner replaces C Free returningNULL. Original99nt flanks,21nt near-tail extension, estimated-length cache invalidation, frame-specific reverse translation, exact actual-length range updates and FENCE writes are retained. Source returns a virtual pointer before its allocation; safe Rust returns borrowed residues plus explicit start_shift/global-exclusive end. Residues exclude both sentinel/FENCE bytes; callers use local index global-start_shift. An absent buffer for source undefined tiny-subject cases returnsNone rather than constructing an invalid pointer. None HSP preserves the source null return. The original source signed arithmetic is retained in its defined integer range.

integration: Expose core::blast_target_translation. Parent has agreed and exposed module; Native formatter uses cache per query/subject list with report::AlignmentReport::translated_subject_range.
API blast_target_translation_new(subject:&[u8],gen_code_string:&[u8;64],program,is_ooframe)->BlastTargetTranslation; Free consumes Option<owner>. Scope enforces Tblastn/non-OOF.

blast_hsp_get_target_translation(&mut cache,Option<&BlastHSP>)->Option<BlastTargetTranslationView>. View.residues is borrowed local-AA sequence, start_shift is its global-AA origin, end is global-exclusive translated end. Access global index i as residues[i-start_shift]; no pointer is formed before an allocation.
